title: Inverse module pullback comparison preserves adjunction-unit sections
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l and f:X→Y, use the actual module comparison b=pullbackModuleIso [def-sf-integral-pullback-module-identification]. For any completed module M on Y, any pro-etale V over Y and any section x of M over V, b inverse applied to the ordinary adjunction-unit section of x over f inverse V equals the ringed adjunction-unit section of x. Both adjunctions are those of [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback] and [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-pullback-comparison].

proof.text: The pushforward comparison is identity on underlying sections: substitute its direct-ring-map equality and evaluate pushforwardCongr.
Uniqueness of left adjoints preserves the adjunction unit; evaluate that identity on x and use naturality of the pushforward comparison to obtain the hom unit-section identity.
Apply b inverse to the hom unit-section identity and use b.hom followed by b.inv equals identity. This yields the inverse formula.

theorem pullbackModuleIso_inv_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt) (x : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    ((pullbackModuleIso l E f).inv.app M).val.app
        (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
      (((ordinaryIntegralModuleAdjunction l E f).unit.app M).val.app (op V) x) =
      (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)).unit.app M).val.app (op V) x)
